stories.summary: They gigged wildly, helped other groups to fame and their songwriting brilliance gave Blondie a signature track. Could a deathbed wish now see the Nerves finally making it big? T he Nerves should have had it all. Formed in 1974 and gifted with earworm melodies, good looks and a painstaking work ethic, the trio of Jack Lee (guitar, vocals), Peter Case (bass, vocals) and Paul Collins (drums, vocals) wrote, rehearsed and gigged as if their lives depended on it. Not quite punk and dismissive of the description “power pop”, they aimed to cram epic brilliance into effervescent, two-minute songs.

stories.summary: Neutrinos are among the most abundant particles in the universe, but they are also among the most elusive. Nearly massless, they are produced by nuclear reactions in the sun, exploding stars, particle accelerators and even the decay of radioactive elements on Earth. They interact so weakly with ordinary matter that trillions pass through each person every second without leaving a trace. Studying these ghostly particles could help answer some of the biggest questions in physics, from the nature of dark matter to why matter exists at all.

stories.title: Has a team ever lost a 3-0 lead in the World Series? Not even close
stories.summary: Has a team in the World Series ever taken a 3-0 lead and lost the series? The answer is 'not even close,' as it turns out. Whether or not it happens Tuesday at Tropicana Field, history is overwhelmingly on Milwaukee's side. On 25 previous occasions since 1903 when a team went up in the World Series, 3-0, that team won the World Series all 25 times. The only example of a team coming back in a best-of-seven format from a 3-0 deficit was a memorable 2004 Boston Red Sox rally against the New York Yankees , the only time in 43 opportunities that a best-of-seven series featured a team ahead, 3-0, and losing the series. The Red Sox went on to win the World Series.

stories.title: Police failings in friends' death on mountain ridge could risk lives, coroner warns
stories.summary: Jayden Long and Eddie Hill died after police failed to adequately escalate a dropped 999 call. More people could die on remote mountains unless police do a better job in responding to dropped 999 calls, a coroner has warned. The bodies of friends Eddie Hill, 20, and Jayden Long, 19, both from Dereham, Norfolk, were found on a mountain ridge in Eryri, also known as Snowdonia , on 19 February, a day after a call from Long to North Wales Police was disconnected. Officers did try unsuccessfully to call him back, but then made "limited" efforts to find out who owned the phone and took more than three hours to alert mountain rescue, assistant coroner Sarah Riley said.

NFL playoff picture: Broncos are AFC's top Wild Card seed
stories.summary: If the season ended today, the Broncos would be the AFC's top Wild Card seed in the playoffs. With a win over the Kansas City Chiefs (5-1) next week, the Broncos would move into first place in the AFC West. As it stands now, Denver's second in the division, above the Las Vegas Raiders (3-4) and Los Angeles Chargers (0-6). The Chiefs are currently the No. 1 seed in the AFC, with the top four seeds going to division leaders. The Broncos are the top Wild Card seed (fifth overall), with a conference wins tiebreaker over the Pittsburgh Steelers (5-2).

stories.title: 7 biggest takeaways from Week 7 of NFL season
stories.summary: Biggest takeaways from Week 7 of the NFL season. Several young players took significant steps forward, while a few teams were left with serious questions heading into the second half of the season. Deshaun Watson threw for 308 yards and once again helped Cleveland pull out a late fourth-quarter victory. Watson completed 25 of 36 passes and added a rushing touchdown as the Browns defeated Tennessee 27-24. Dylan Sampson and Quinshon Judkins were both active and contributed to the running game, combining for 23 carries and 141 yards with two touchdowns. KC Concepcion is another player who is rapidly becoming a weapon for Todd Monken.
